headline: Dangote Cement Posts $714 Million Profit Ahead of London Listing
summary: Dangote Cement Plc reported a $714 million profit for the first nine months of 2026 as the company prepares for a planned $1 billion secondary listing in London.
why: As Africa's largest cement producer, Dangote Cement's financial performance and international listings provide a key benchmark for investor sentiment toward African industrial assets.

impacts.name: Dangote Cement Plc
impacts.why: Robust nine-month profits strengthen balance sheet metrics ahead of a planned international share listing.
